blocks.title: ① 순위 상승폭 (New & Trending · Top Sellers)

items.name: Little Kitty, Big City
items.sub: Double Dagger Studio · Cats, Cute, Exploration
items.desc: You're a curious little kitty with a big personality, on an adventure to find your way back home. Explore the city, make new friends with stray animals, wear delightful hats, and leave more than a little chaos in your wake. After all, isn't that what cats do best?

items.name: Round and Round Inc.
items.desc: A black-and-white incremental game about one revolving door. Turn it, let people in, and spend the earnings on a bigger door and better blades, until the corner shop's little door is a human pump swallowing the whole city. The goal: admit all of humanity.

items.name: Liar's Bar
items.desc: Dive into this multiplayer online experience set in a sketchy bar where the games are as dangerous as the patrons. Join a table of 4 and test your skills in Liar's Dice and Liar's Deck, where lying and bluffing are key to victory. Ready for a night at Liar's Bar?

items.name: BALL PICKER - Clean Up the Golf Yard
items.desc: Collect hundreds of thousands of golf balls, earn money, buy new tools, and clean up the golf yard. BALL PICKER is an active incremental game centered on the quiet satisfaction of tidying up.

items.name: KORRIDOR
items.desc: Fight off hordes of demons in this unforgiving gates shooter! Slay monsters, pick up upgrades, and create overpowered builds to annihilate bosses while listening to heavy metal tracks. Many foes and secrets await you in the catacombs...

items.name: Underbloom
items.desc: Under a forest that forgot how to grow, one small mushroom wakes up. Spread a glowing web through nine hidden worlds, meet their small, strange neighbours, and wake the Heartseed. A cozy incremental game with a real ending.

items.name: 9 Kings
items.desc: A fast-paced roguelike kingdom builder. Grow your empire and fight massive battles against powerful rival kings. Break the game with thousands of insane builds to become the King of Kings.

items.name: MECCHA CHAMELEON
items.desc: Paint yourself to blend in! "Meccha Chameleon" is a new-sensation hide-and-seek game where you paint your white body to mimic the stage. Spot, pose, and "artistic skill" are keys to survival. Deceive Seekers with techniques that put chameleons to shame! Supports public matches and streaming.

items.name: Dressmaker
items.desc: Become a dressmaker! Choose fabric, cut out pattern pieces and sew them all together to make the dresses of your dreams - in this cozy crafting game, inspired by real dressmaking.

items.name: How to Fish
items.desc: A 1-4 player physics based fishing simulator. While drinking and boating you suddenly crash into a small island. To work your way back home you have to learn How to Fish.

items.name: Happy Wheels
items.desc: Choose your inadequately prepared racer, and disregard severe consequences in your desperate pursuit of short-lived victory.

items.name: ReStory: Chill Electronics Repairs
items.desc: Run a quaint electronics repair shop in mid-2000s Tokyo. Grow your business by carefully restoring iconic video game consoles, cell phones, music players, and other nostalgic devices. Talk to customers, hear their stories, and see how your decisions impact both their lives and your shop.

items.name: over the hill
items.desc: Explore the world in the golden age of offroading. Drive iconic 4x4 vehicles from the 60s to 80s by yourself or with friends through challenging trails and beautiful scenery.

items.name: Round and Round Inc.
items.desc: A black-and-white incremental game about one revolving door. Turn it, let people in, and spend the earnings on a bigger door and better blades, until the corner shop's little door is a human pump swallowing the whole city. The goal: admit all of humanity.

items.name: Liar's Bar
items.desc: Dive into this multiplayer online experience set in a sketchy bar where the games are as dangerous as the patrons. Join a table of 4 and test your skills in Liar's Dice and Liar's Deck, where lying and bluffing are key to victory. Ready for a night at Liar's Bar?

items.name: Warhammer Survivors
items.desc: Warhammer Survivors is the official grim and dark bullet-heaven game from the developers of Warhammer 40,000 Boltgun. Play as over 40 iconic champions from the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer Age of Sigmar universes and obliterate those who champion death and destruction.

items.name: Godius Eternal War
items.desc: A classic 2D pixel MMORPG inspired by the golden age of online RPGs. Join nation wars, explore an open multiplayer world, trade with players, battle in PvP, and experience a community-driven adventure that has continued since 1999.

items.name: Alchemy Factory
items.desc: Start small, team up with friends, and automate production with conveyor belts, pipes, and magical devices. Stock your shop with potions, jewelry, and relics, complete commissions, and build an alchemy empire! Alchemy Factory 1.0 is out now with the Wagon Logistics System and revamped shopkeeping.

items.name: Little Kitty, Big City
items.sub: Double Dagger Studio · Cats, Cute, Exploration
items.desc: You're a curious little kitty with a big personality, on an adventure to find your way back home. Explore the city, make new friends with stray animals, wear delightful hats, and leave more than a little chaos in your wake. After all, isn't that what cats do best?

items.name: Esports Manager 2026
items.desc: Build and lead your own professional esports organization. Scout players, manage contracts, develop talent, hire staff, grow your brand, and compete for championship titles in a deep and realistic management simulation.

items.name: Jump Space
items.sub: Keepsake Games · Action, Adventure, Early Access
items.desc: Jump Space (formerly Jump Ship) is a mission based co-op PvE for 1-4 players, where you are the crew of a spaceship. Transition seamlessly from crewing the ship to on-foot exploration and space walks. Explore, upgrade, and survive intense encounters in deep space together.

items.name: Crime Simulator
items.desc: You’re out of jail, but the debt isn’t gone. Sneak, steal, and break into houses solo or in 4-player co-op. Use lockpicks, sleeping gas, and brute force to complete jobs, outsmart security, and make enough money before time runs out. Will you pay back what you owe, or lose everything?

items.name: Yet Another Zombie Survivors
items.sub: Awesome Games Studio · Bullet Heaven, Zombies, Action Roguelike
items.desc: The Horde is coming, but you're ready to fight it! Assemble your squad, choose their upgrades, and build powerful synergies against thousands of undead. Survive. Then evolve. Then break every limit in this deceptively simple but addictive bullet heaven game.

items.name: Incremental Pachinko Heaven
items.desc: Launch balls! Upgrade the board! Earn mountains of medals—and keep paying off your debt! A short pachinko incremental with a skill tree that keeps giving you new ways to earn!

items.name: Murmurs of Fear - A whisper of loneliness
items.desc: Murmurs of Fear is a psychological horror about those left alone with the unexplainable. It is a self-contained story about fear, isolation, and the struggle to stay sane as reality itself begins to fracture.

items.name: Eldwyn's Dungeon Academy
items.desc: Eldwyn's Dungeon Academy is an SNES-era inspired top-down action-adventure game where you explore magical dungeons, collect tools, fight monsters, overcome traps, solve puzzles, and find hidden treasures. What grade will you get? This game is proudly human-made.

items.name: Forge the Fates
items.desc: Take deckbuilding to the next level. Transform your hand of cards into a tactical grid of runes. Plan, shift, and strike to unleash powerful combos and chain match-3 bonuses. Choose your hero, master their deck, and fight through deadly dungeons to face a mysterious dark overlord.

items.name: Necro Rising
items.desc: Defeat the horde. Raise the fallen into a skeleton legion and lead it with your spells. Reclaim the Seal of Return, bring the dead home, and rebuild a workshop and a camp where people await your return. Eastern dark fantasy action. Play the free demo.
